raw_response:
Alright, let me think through this year the way I always do.

---

*Aiya, 55 years I've been on this land. Me and the old lady, just us two at home now — the kids went to Beijing and Shijiazhuang long ago. 8 mu isn't much but at my age it's plenty.*

*I split it the same way I always do. Out west where the soil is a bit lighter and sandier, I keep 2 mu in cotton. The other 6 mu I do wheat then maize, one after the other, like everyone in the village. That's how it's always been.*

**On the wheat (6 mu):**
*Plant around early October after I clear the maize stalks. I buy seed from the township supply shop, the same kind Old Wang next door uses — he gets good yield so I figure it's fine. Before planting I put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer per mu, the 15-15-15 kind, that's what the shop owner sells everyone. Then when the wheat comes up green in spring, if it looks a little yellow at jointing I'll scatter maybe half a bag of urea per mu on top. I water it when I turn the ground in winter, then again at jointing, and once more when the grain is filling if there's no rain. Water from the well costs money, the electricity bill adds up, so I don't water extra if I don't have to. Usually I get around 400 kg per mu, sometimes a bit more if the spring rain is good.*

**On the maize (same 6 mu, after wheat):**
*As soon as the wheat combine finishes in June I have to hurry — the maize has to go in within a few days or it won't mature before frost. I don't till, just plant straight into the wheat stubble with a seeder I hire from a neighbor, costs me maybe 30 yuan per mu. Hybrid seed, the bag says it's drought-tolerant. I put compound fertilizer in the furrow with the seed, 1.5 bags per mu, and then at the big flare stage I topdress urea, maybe 15 kg per mu. If July-August is dry I'll water once, maybe twice. Usually I get 450 kg per mu. I sell some, keep some for the chickens.*

**On the cotton (2 mu):**
*Cotton is hard work for an old man, but I've grown it my whole life and the price has been decent the last couple years. Plant end of April when the soil warms. I use the seed I saved from last year, mixed with a little new. Put down 1.5 bags of compound before planting, then urea when it starts squaring, about 10 kg per mu. The bollworm always comes so I spray insecticide 3 or 4 times through the summer — I don't like spending the money but without it I'd lose half the crop. Water once before flowering if dry. Picking is the hardest part — my wife helps and we pay my nephew's daughter-in-law a bit to help for a week or two in October. I usually get around 250 kg of lint per mu, which is okay for this land.*

*Total I'll probably spend around 3,500 yuan on inputs. That's about what I spent last year. Can't go much higher, pension and what the kids send is what I live on outside of harvest.*
